deadline.value: January 2, 11:59 pm Eastern (year inferred from the 2026-27 cycle).

gre_general.value: GRE scores are required in the 2026 admissions cycle.
gre_general.quote: As of the 2026 admissions cycle, we require GRE scores.

supervisor.value: Contacting potential advisors in the fall is encouraged but not strictly necessary.
supervisor.quote: While it’s not strictly necessary, we encourage you to contact relevant faculty via email before applying

funding.value: All accepted students are fully funded, including summers, through completion with satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: Yes, all students accepted into our graduate program are fully funded, including summers, through a combination of departmental/university support, grant-supported research assistantships, and/or outside fellowships. Funding is guaranteed through completion assuming satisfactory progress in the program.

also.quote: Every PhD student receives a funding package that covers the full cost of tuition and provides a stipend to cover basic living costs like rent, food, and books — for a minimum of five years.

entry_route.value: A master's is not needed; some applicants hold one and others come straight from a bachelor's.
entry_route.quote: Do I need to have a Master’s degree to apply to the Ph.D. program? No. Some of our applicants have a Master’s degree, while others are coming straight from a Bachelor’s degree.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study
